name: Diemelstadt (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of black, yellow and black, charged above the centre with the city arms of Diemelstadt (a red castle with a star on white).
history: On 22 May 1979 the Hessian Minister of the Interior approved the flag, showing the arms on a black-yellow-black cloth.

features.role: Diemelstadt arms — red castle on white
